**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refuse no-open backup while daemon owns store**

The no-open path bypasses daemon dispatch and can copy an inconsistent DB+WAL snapshot.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Detect zero-record replay of checkpoint WALs**

Lenient replay can accept a stale main-database view when no checkpoint records were recovered.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the newly quarantined WAL during pruning**

Pruning can delete the WAL that was just renamed to .corrupted because rename preserves mtime.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Persist provenance for no-open status commands**

Recovery provenance is process-local, so a separate daemon run reports none.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->
